first_slice.purpose: Useful direct scalar mutation budgets and caller-visible mutation provenance independent of strict clone admission. General effects/purity and side-effect density are not established.
bounded_extensions: ordinary if/else direct assignment-site inventory when calls/formal-use observations are unrequested
lexical shadowed-binding roots; existing block-scope capability checked explicitly
later: density with complete event and statement denominators

events: root declaration identity and lexical scope
caller-visible pointee mutation flag with supporting provenance
evidence_contract.counts: Exact counts require complete bounded operation and root inventory. Opaque regions produce lower bounds only when actual witnessed source sites justify them. Unknown target denominator remains unknown.
evidence_contract.density: Not evaluated by initial slice. Later density needs complete chosen statement denominator and effect-event vocabulary/weights; a supported-remainder ratio is neither exact nor automatically a lower bound.
evidence_contract.trust: Reuse checked immutable captured original source/native evidence and selected context. No current source-tree reread on saved replay; corrupt/wrong-context evidence fails rather than being salvaged. No new SHA or global proof cache.

cases.reason: Primitive reads/arithmetic are not mutation sites. This is no claim of panic freedom or total purity.

cases.source: pub fn local()->u32 { let mut value=0u32; value=1; value=2; value }
cases.reason: Declaration initialization is not reassignment. Exactly two direct write sites are at the test limit.

cases.source: pub fn owned(mut value:u32)->u32 { value=1; value=2; value=3; value }
cases.reason: Reassigning an owned scalar formal changes local state, not the caller-owned pointee.
Each explicit pointee assignment escapes through the mutable formal; direct mutation effects deduplicate by exact root if that legacy-compatible view is offered.
Builtin u32 compound assignment is one syntactic write site, not separate read/write mutation events; overloaded AddAssign requires separate evidence.

cases.source: pub fn locals()->u32 { let mut a=0u32; let mut b=0u32; a=1; b=2; a+b }
cases.reason: Two separately declared roots exceed max_mutated_targets=1 even though no individual root exceeds two writes.

cases.source: pub fn opaque(target:&mut u32,callback:fn(&mut u32)) { callback(target); }
cases.reason: No witnessed direct assignment is not proof of no callee mutation/effects.

cases.source: pub fn witnessed(target:&mut u32,callback:fn(&mut u32)) { *target=1; *target=2; *target=3; callback(target); }
cases.reason: Witnessed direct source sites establish an over-budget root while unknown remainder prevents a whole-function clean result or ratio.
Count the explicit syntactic write site, retaining its RHS call boundary. The store is not guaranteed to execute if the callback diverges/panics.

cases.source: pub fn shadow()->u32 { let mut value=0u32; value=1; { let mut value=2u32; value=3; } value }
cases.reason: Root identity is declaration+lexical scope, not the display name value. If scope proof is unavailable, outcome must be unavailable rather than merge.

cases.source: pub fn branch(target:&mut u32,flag:bool) { if flag { *target=1; } else { *target=2; } }
cases.reason: Two static write sites, not two dynamic writes along one execution. This count contract must be explicit; unsupported branch traversal stays incomplete.

cases.source: pub fn repeated(target:&mut u32,count:u32) { for _ in 0..count { *target=1; } }
cases.reason: The original primitive half-open u32 for-loop body has one static assignment site regardless of iterations, including zero. No unrolling, termination, dynamic write-count or density inference follows from this inventory.

cases.source: pub fn redirected<'a>(mut target:&'a mut u32,other:&'a mut u32) { target=other; *target=1; }
cases.reason: The pointee write cannot be attributed to the stale original target formal. Track reference reassignment or retain unavailable provenance.

cases.source: pub fn aliased(target:&mut u32) { let alias=&mut *target; *alias=1; }
cases.reason: Alias handling needs its own provenance proof; spelling alias cannot establish a new independent caller-visible target.
Closure-body assignment is deferred and cannot be counted as an immediately executed outer write. An opaque body/capture is not empty/pure.

cases.source: pub fn invoked(target:&mut u32) { let mut callback=|| { *target=1; }; callback(); }
cases.reason: Invoking a closure does not grant a checked helper/effect summary or permission to flatten its body into outer events.

cases.source: macro_rules! assign { ($target:expr)=>{ *$target=1 } } pub fn expanded(target:&mut u32) { assign!(target); }
cases.reason: Do not count an omitted original macro call as zero or grant generated-body effect authority by expansion spelling.

cases.source: pub struct Pair { pub left:u32,pub right:u32 } pub fn fields(value:&mut Pair) { value.left=1; value.right=2; }

initial_slice.reason: composite field and alias provenance outside scalar-root scope

cases.reason: Do not silently apply a field policy to a root-only observation or treat different fields as independent effects without appropriate evidence.
Unknown aliases/unsafe/drop behavior cannot become no-write or pure. Independent per-kind status may expose known witnessed operations without a total effect claim.

legacy_comparison.intentional_boundary: Legacy mutation events also include mutable borrows and have broader syntax/effect propagation. This new initial direct-assignment site contract does not claim equal event counts, density or full replacement. Legacy dynamic unknown-call weighting is not proof of all callee effects.
legacy_comparison.retirement: No legacy capability retired by prepared fixtures or narrower useful mutation delivery.

validation_gate: Independently execute declared initial cases against real Cargo captured evidence and strict imported replay.
Show witnessed findings retained alongside explicit incomplete scope; exit2 takes precedence for incompleteness.
Test original event spans/lexical root identities/provenance; do not validate only counts copied from producer.
Mark next/later cases unsupported until evidence contract is implemented; do not call the full file delivered.
